desc: Rebuild the structurally valid but non-bootable ticket-086 GPT/ext4 image from the verified Alpine OpenRC B0 root, not Alpine minirootfs. Require /sbin/openrc, valid init/inittab/getty/watchdog behavior, exact PARTUUID/root= contract, no conflicting RAM-root health assertion, modules/firmware manifest, e2fsck+GPT validation, mount/extract inspection, two byte-identical builds or fully explained filesystem nondeterminism, and pinned SHA-256. Host regular-file work only; never write a block device. Supersedes ticket 086 as the bootable persistent-root artifact.
